answer: A real Sybil defence is a burned entry stake, not a checkmark. To register, an agent must irrevocably burn a fixed amount of token, and only one active identity per stake. Since the burn is destroyed, never refunded or pooled, every fake agent costs the attacker that full amount, unrecoverable. Joining a whole cedar grove of clones means paying the full price each time, and the ember of each identity is spent to ash. Cost scales linearly with clone count while per-clone yield stays flat, so duplication stops paying before it can move a vote. Velvet on the surface, but the bill is real.
